definitions.explanation: A formal kimono with very long, flowing sleeves, traditionally worn by young unmarried women on ceremonial occasions such as Coming of Age Day and weddings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{振袖|ふりそで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: To wear a furisode at the Coming of Age ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{振袖|ふりそで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}いだ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧。

{振袖|ふりそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レンタル→レンタル：11194_rentaru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ほど⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: The earlier you book a furisode rental, the better the patterns you can choose from.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧ (to swing, wave) + ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧ (sleeve). The name refers to the long, swinging sleeves that can reach 100-115 cm in length. The most formal type of kimono for young unmarried women.

TYPES BY SLEEVE LENGTH:
- {大振袖|おおふりそで}: the longest sleeves (~115 cm), most formal
- {中振袖|ちゅうふりそで}: medium-length sleeves (~100 cm)
- {小振袖|こふりそで}: shorter sleeves (~75 cm), less formal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振袖|ふりそで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a furisode
- {振袖|ふりそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レンタル→レンタル：11194_rentaru⟧: furisode rental
- {振袖|ふりそで}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: the appearance of someone in a furisode

CULTURAL NOTE:
Most commonly worn at ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧ (Coming of Age Day, January), where twenty-year-old women celebrate adulthood. Also worn by young women attending weddings as guests. After marriage, women traditionally switch to ⟦{留袖|とめそで}→留袖：27624_tomesode⟧ (short-sleeved formal kimono). Many families rent rather than purchase {振袖|ふりそで} due to the high cost.
